comments.author: Moriel
comments.body:
Lol trying to figure out who in the world that first poster after me was. i wish people would use their real IGN so we can have an adult discussion and exchange of opinions, instead of childish remarks that really serve no purpose whatsoever.

Here is my logic and feel free to debate my viewpoint, im not afraid of debating my opinion and considering other points of view

Im mainly looking to invest someplace. I currently have several bil saved and i want court ranks. Some players spend billions on a ETC or a FBTC, or 200m - 900m on one of several special sails that add wave resist or turn speed. (which i think is foolish but these are separate arguements and i dont wanna derail the topic)

The point is there isnt really alot of things to spend money on at end game, and its very easy to accululate a few hundred mil.

Ive chosen to spend my money Investing and gaining progress towards court ranks, and in the process add new trade goods to the game. Socotra is an area that is obtained much sooner than East asia, and if dragons blood is worth anything at all it might at least be a secondary option to pepper for low level players, and give another reason to rank up medicine trade. Maybe this seems foolish to you, but i really didnt ask your opinion, and neither did the other players that want to invest here.

If i knew what you spend your hundreds of millions on it would seem just as foolish to me no doubt but you wont see me jumping into other threads tossing insults around.

At the very least leave your IGN if you feel so strongy that we are wasting money, and give us what your opinion is on how we should better spend it. Once we know your IGN we can debate the issue
